remainingNames.name: Árkosháza-puszta

sourcesChecked.finding: Primary historical register confirms Árkosháza puszta as a Babosdöbréte dependent locality, 1840–1880.
Interview reports Árkosháza has disappeared; 1949 census affiliation is named.
Organizer map text contains the locality label; no actual historic boundary geometry was retrieved or traced.
Actual shared native context reviewed: no farmyard/residential polygon or named place-related road; unnamed tracks around the saved position do not establish the old compound.
OSM/Overpass web connector raw-data fetch capability checked, unavailable; no shell network request made.

remainingNames.reason: Historical name and position are supported, but no source establishes the extent of the vanished farm settlement. A hull around unnamed tracks, nearby forest or the name point would invent its spatial identity. Existing fallback must remain.
remainingNames.nextUsefulEvidence: Historic cadastral/topographic map showing the former compound, or a surviving source farm/building footprint. No alias to adjacent settlements is supported.

remainingNames.name: Sandipuszta

sourcesChecked.finding: Academic primary place-name register records Sandipuszta/Sandi as a flat agricultural/settlement place in 1974, also in 1862/1864/1967.
Primary archival catalogue identifies Sándipuszta as Gyugy part.
The source separately names Sandi-szőlő and Sandi-tábla; they cannot be blindly treated as the same settlement.

Actual native context reviewed: farm access track 19 m from label, adjacent woodland about 43 m away, no retained farmyard/residential surface. Neighboring Alsómajor is separately named and not an alias.
Attempted official OSM map and Overpass building-geometry fetch through allowed web connector; both unavailable.

remainingNames.reason: Name/history/position are supported, but the visible current track/woodland/vineyard data do not define a trustworthy settlement compound. Substituting Alsómajor, Sandi-szőlő or an arbitrary track envelope would assert an unsupported identity. Existing fallback must remain.
remainingNames.nextUsefulEvidence: Anonymous building/farmyard footprints near the saved place; shared context extraction omitted plain building=* ways without name/addr:place/suburb. A centralized residual-building extraction or historic cadastral map may recover the compound.
